text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
In this highly anticipated event race!
Vivlos is surging up from the far outside!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos crosses the finish line!!
In first place is Vivlos—!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Onee-chan! I did it~!!
I won~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And so!
Here we are on our reward date♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's been so long since I had a day off~!
I'm gonna enjoy it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You've worked hard this whole time,
after all. All to win that race.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. ...Yeah, I worked super hard!
I gave it everything I had!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sooo give me lots and lots of rewards today!
Let me pamper myself with you, Onee-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go, let's go!
First up is the roller coaster♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That doggy pie looks so dreamy~♡
But the kitty omurice is super cute for photos too~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ I can't decide. Maybe the doggy one...?
But then the kitty one...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll order the kitty one...
Why don't you get the doggy one?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aww~ I love you so much, Onee-chan♡
I'm gonna take pictures of both!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Onee-chan.
Can I buy this little guy before we leave?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That way whenever I look at him, I can
remember today's date anytime♪ Right?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You're impossible...
I'll buy it for you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Thank you, Onee-chan!
I'll treasure it♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You really are an expert at getting spoiled... Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Come now, it's about time we head back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from shopping, as I walked along
the riverbank, a baseball rolled over to my feet.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Excuse meee!!
Could you throw that ball back, pleaseee?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was quite a distance, but thinking "Reach them!",
I threw it with all my might.
To my surprise, the throw had just the right power—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~!! Nice pitch!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That was such a clean pitching form~!!
You're amazing, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Onee-chan.
We used to play catch with the family back then!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I kind of feel like playing now♪
Trainer-san, play with us, let's play~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It'll be so much fun
if we do it together! Right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry over here!
Pleease, Trainer-san♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos! Honestly—
I apologize, Trainer-san.
Would you mind indulging her for just a bit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving in to her begging, we ended up playing catch
until the sun went down—
